summary.text: Paul Sawyer is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 69 (East Baton Rouge Parish), and was elected in 2026, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Paul Sawyer's occupation as Management and Project Development Consulting.
It lists education as B.A., Southern Methodist University; M.A., Johns Hopkins University.

The page lists committee assignments including Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, Natural Resources and Environment, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and the House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
